consent.title: Verification request
consent.subtitle: {client} has asked to verify your details.

verify.footer: Secured by Recrify · Consent-first background checks
verify.pageSubtitle: This information will be used to complete your background verification.

consent.heading: {client} has started your background verification
consent.body: Review the Terms & Conditions below, then give your consent to continue. You can decline any time — nothing about you is verified or stored.
consent.checksBody: These checks start only after you tap Agree & continue — nothing has been checked yet.
consent.agreeLabel: I, {name}, have read and agree to the Terms & Conditions, and consent to Recrify verifying my details on behalf of {client}.

decline.title: Decline this verification?
decline.body: The request will be closed and {client} will be notified. Nothing about you will be verified or stored. This cannot be undone.
decline.doneBody: Thanks for letting us know. This request is now closed and none of your details were checked. You can safely close this page.

form.title: Personal Information
form.subtitle: Make sure these match your Aadhaar records.
form.name: Name
form.aadhaarError: Aadhaar number must be exactly 12 digits ({count}/12).

aadhaar.title: Verify your Aadhaar
aadhaar.body: We use DigiLocker (Government of India) to securely verify your Aadhaar. You'll be redirected to give consent.
aadhaar.awaitingTitle: Complete the consent in the DigiLocker tab…
aadhaar.awaitingBody: This page will update automatically once you finish. If the tab didn't open, use the button below.

done.title: Aadhaar verified — you're all set
done.body: Thanks, {firstName}. Your verification is complete. You can close this window.

newCheck.title: Add a new candidate
newCheck.subtitle: Enter candidate details to start the background verification.

basic.heading: Capture the candidate's contact details to get started.
basic.name: Full name

additional.heading: Enter additional details of the person you want to verify.
additional.addressPlaceholder: House / street, area, city, state, PIN

documents.heading: Identity documents
documents.hint: JPG, PNG, or PDF up to 10MB
documents.uploadHint: Add any identity documents you have — the more you provide, the more complete the background check.

review.heading: Verify the details before proceeding to payment.

errors.pan: PAN must match the format ABCDE1234F.
errors.dobFormat: Date of birth must be in DD-MM-YYYY format.
errors.dobRequired: Date of birth is required when providing a Driving Licence or Passport. Add it under Additional Details.
errors.drivingLicence: Driving licence number looks too short.
errors.passport: Passport file number looks too short.
errors.voterId: Voter ID must be in the format ABC1234567.
errors.terms: Please accept the Terms & Conditions to continue.

newCheck.consentCalloutBody: All checks start only after the candidate accepts the consent agreement. If they decline or don't respond, the full amount is refunded to your wallet.
newCheck.aadhaarHelp: Only the candidate can verify their Aadhaar. After payment, we'll email them a secure DigiLocker link.
newCheck.uploadHelp: Upload at least one valid ID from Aadhaar, PAN, Voter ID, or Driving Licence. Every file is virus-scanned before it is stored.
newCheck.termsIntro: By checking the box below, you agree to our <terms></terms> and confirm you have obtained the candidate's consent.

pay.shortfall: Your wallet is short by ₹{amount}. Contact us to top it up.
pay.acceptTerms: Accept the Terms & Conditions to continue.

upload.type: {file}: only PDF, JPG, or PNG files are allowed.

discount.invalid: That code is invalid or expired.
discount.failed: Could not validate the code. Please try again.

payment.notConfigured: Payments are not configured. Please contact support.
payment.unconfirmed: Payment could not be confirmed. Please try again.
payment.startFailed: Could not start the payment. Please try again.
